verdict.rationale: Lambda documents SSH access to On-Demand Cloud instances using your own imported SSH key. Root-level control is documented explicitly only for Managed Slurm clusters ("sudo or root across the cluster"); for single ODC instances, the evidence implies control through the GPU Base image and cloud-init but never states root or sudo access. missing for 10: explicit documentation of root/sudo access on standard ODC GPU instances, independent hands-on corroboration of SSH-plus-root workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can SSH into my GPU instance with my own keys and get root-level control of the environment

citations.quote: You can connect to your On-Demand Cloud (ODC) instances directly through SSH or by using the preinstalled JupyterLab server.
If you have an existing SSH key, you can add it to a workspace and use it to connect to your instances.
All nodes are directly accessible, and users have system administrator privileges (sudo or root) across the cluster.
Use if: You want a minimal working setup with a high degree of control over your Python environment.
